category: udp port forward (demo relay, open-source client)

free_tier.stated: You can give it a try with wstunnel demo server

egress.terms: no allowance published for the demo relay; it is described as a way to check that you can bypass a proxy, not as a service; ingress: udp

chaining: wstunnel -R udp://51820 on any free VM, or the demo relay if it permits the binding; this is the shape that composes with a free compute lane

limits.value: the demo server allowlists one tunnel: 'The tunnel is the only one that is going to be allowed.'

binding_note: The demo relay's allowlist is the first thing that fails, before any byte count: the documented example is a single fixed TCP forward, so a reverse UDP binding is not established to be permitted at all.

identity_cost.detail: the demo takes a shared password: '-P demo' with wss://ws.erebe.dev, no account

reliability_note: a shared demo endpoint with no stated capacity; the operator can withdraw it without notice
confidence_note: Unverified because the demo's UDP permission was not tested and its capacity is unpublished. What would settle it: run wstunnel client -R 'udp://51820:127.0.0.1:51820' -P demo wss://ws.erebe.dev, send a WireGuard handshake to the reported port, and read wg show.

evidence.proved: the demo server, the -P demo shared password, the allowlist sentence, and the -R udp:// reverse UDP form in the client usage block
repository metadata: 'Tunnel all your traffic over Websocket or HTTP2 - Bypass firewalls/DPI', public, not archived

notes: The client is genuinely capable of a reverse UDP port and is the standard tool for carrying WireGuard over TCP 443. The free part is the demo relay, which is explicitly a courtesy.

extras.wg_detail: the client carries raw UDP both ways and reverse mode binds a port on the server: 'udp://1212:1.1.1.1:53 => listen on server for incoming udp on port 1212 and forward to cloudflare dns 1.1.1.1 on port 53 from local machine'. Whether the shared demo relay at wss://ws.erebe.dev permits a reverse UDP binding is not documented.
extras.volume_stated: no allowance published for the demo relay; it is described as a way to check that you can bypass a proxy, not as a service
extras.transit_note: the wstunnel server unwraps the websocket and emits the datagrams
